newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Jan 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Jan 1.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following major business stories on January 1:
NEW YORK - The Dow Jones industrial average fell 101 points, ending a sweet year on a sour note.
WASHINGTON - As the new year begins, millions of Americans are puzzling over how to divide up the money in their retirement accounts.
NEW YORK - Boding well for continued economic strength in 1997, two reports showed consumer confidence at a seven-year high and new home sales up dramatically.
WASHINGTON - James Quello, a 22-year member of the Federal Communications Commission, said he will not ask the Clinton Administration to nominate him for another term.

WASHINGTON - The Teamsters strike againt Giant Food Inc. entered its 17th day while both sides reassessed their positions in a dispute that has been essentially reduced to a single issue - job security.
